text:
I'm sorry your order arrived damaged, that's frustrating. Because a refund over $150 is involved, a human Support Lead needs to handle this, and I'm escalating it to them now.

To help the review go smoothly, please have photos of the damaged items and the box ready. Damage needs to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so if you're still inside that window, please report it now. If it's past 48 hours, tell me the delivery date and I'll include that in the escalation.

I can't promise the outcome or give a timeframe for the Support Lead's reply, since the policy doesn't specify one. You can also email help@leafy.example, which is answered within 1 business day.
